description: Clusters of BC/agent-point cash-outs using Aadhaar authentication at rural customer service points; pattern documented in Jharkhand/UP rural fraud reporting (e.g. Jamtara-region rings covered in national press and state police press releases).
Stolen funds split across many urban ATMs in one metro region within hours of the fraud; matches published police accounts of metro ATM cash-out crews in Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram.
Accounts opened across several states and banks; layering moves funds cross-state before cash-out; consistent with inter-state gang busts reported by MHA/I4C and state police.
High-value withdrawals at branch counters via current accounts and self cheques; reported in bank-fraud CBI/state cases involving shell current accounts.
Mule accounts concentrated in payments banks / SFBs with agent-assisted onboarding; cash-out via micro-ATMs and agents; flagged in RBI/NPCI advisories on BC-channel abuse covered in press.
Cluster activated for under a week around a campaign, then abandoned; matches police descriptions of disposable mule batches sourced via Telegram job scams.
Aged accounts kept dormant for months and activated in bursts; noted in investigative reporting on rented-account networks (accounts rented from students/villagers).
Runners stationed near ATMs in multiple states withdraw on cue from a remote operator; matches arrested runner-gang reports from Delhi-NCR and Mumbai police.
Local caller crews run OTP phishing and cash out at nearby agents/ATMs; pattern grounded in extensive public reporting on Jamtara (JH) and similar eastern-UP/Bihar belts (no individuals named).
Fake call centres impersonating LEA/support drive victims to transfer into layered accounts; grounded in CBI Operation Chakra busts and Noida/Gurugram call-centre raids covered publicly.
Layers of shell-firm current accounts for high-value fraud proceeds, cashed at branches; mirrors ED/CBI press releases on shell-entity laundering.
Fraud proceeds partly converted to crypto via P2P, remainder cashed at ATMs/agents; pattern described in I4C/state-police advisories on USDT off-ramps covered in press.
